title: A little room to pause.
headline:
A little room
to pause.
subhead: One quiet moment at a time
scene: Warm cream background. Right-side matte lavender pebble character with sleepy curved eyes gently rests on a softly rounded terracotta cushion beside a tilted charcoal phone showing only a large simple pause symbol. One small peach sun and a pale-lilac cloud above. Left-side dark-plum rounded sans headline, ample empty space, tactile clay, tender studio shadows.
